two_moons.support_caveat: unbounded noise; does not satisfy compact-support theorem
two_moons.decoder: MLP comparison and exact weighted Euclidean Frechet means

eight_gaussians.support_caveat: unbounded noise; does not satisfy compact-support theorem
eight_gaussians.decoder: MLP comparison and exact weighted Euclidean Frechet means

sphere.data: three tangent-disk components at radius .45, disk radius .08; north exponential map
sphere.support: north-pole geodesic cap of radius <= .53 < pi/4
sphere.decoder: unrolled Karcher iteration from normalized weighted Euclidean mean
sphere.solver_caveat: gradient residual reported; not a certified global objective-gap estimate

tree.metric: shortest path on fixed compact three-edge unit metric star
tree.data: branch masses .2/.3/.4 and vertex atom .1; radius .2+.8*Beta(2,2)
tree.decoder: exact weighted Frechet mean using positive folded branch moment
tree.baseline: ambient one-hot/radius DDPM with nearest Euclidean star projection

distributions.metric: exact 1D W2 between equally weighted sorted-atom measures
distributions.data: bounded location/scale/skew family of normal/exponential quantile mixtures
distributions.objects: 32 equal-mass atoms per distribution, not exact continuous laws
distributions.decoder: exact Frechet barycenter: weighted average of sorted atoms
distributions.baseline: ambient quantile DDPM with increasing rearrangement

seed_scheme: SeedSequence([20261101, training_seed, dataset_index, role, draw]); 31-bit state
selection: fit-validation only; common raw embedded MSE for decoder checkpoints/candidates
evaluation: three independent roles: training, fit-validation, fresh evaluation; equal-count exact assignment
uncertainty: average evaluation draws within training seed; SD and t interval across seed means
scope: four MLP losses and three landmark rules on planar data; primary-loss Frechet decoders with FPS on extensions
baseline_caveat: ambient repaired DDPM is not an official intrinsic-manifold baseline reproduction
reference_coverage_caveat: reported maxima on evaluation objects are empirical probes, not certified support suprema
status_caveat: completed computation does not imply a favorable outcome or paper readiness
